# Third-party patches

VidE keeps upstream sources under `external/` as unmodified as possible. The few
changes that are required are documented here. Each patch is intentionally
minimal and isolated. All hooks are **read-only** (they copy existing decoder
state; they never change decoding behaviour) and are guarded so they cost
nothing beyond the copy.

## Machine-readable diffs (`.patch`)

`HM.patch`, `VTM.patch`, `JM.patch`, `libvpx.patch` are unified diffs of the
VidE changes made to each vendored tree, generated by re-cloning upstream and
diffing against `external/<codec>` (CR-insensitive):

- **HM.patch / VTM.patch** — diff vs release tags **HM-16.22** / **VTM-19.2**
  (exact: the tree contains only VidE changes).
- **JM.patch** — diff vs **JM-19.1**, limited to the VidE-touched files (the
  original tree was cloned from the default-branch tip, which is slightly ahead
  of the 19.1 tag).
- **libvpx.patch** — diff vs **v1.17.0**, limited to the VidE-touched files
  (`vp9_capture.*`, `vp9_decodeframe.c`, `vp9_detokenize.c`, `vp9dx.mk`,
  `bitreader.*`).
- **libaom** — no patch file (the vendored tree is an old pre-OBU revision with
  no matching release tag to diff against).

Regenerate with, e.g.:
```sh
diff -ruN --strip-trailing-cr --exclude=.git --exclude=lib --exclude=bin \
  <pristine-HM> external/HM | sed 's#<pristine-HM>#external/HM#g'
```

## HM (HEVC Test Model) 16.22

Location: `external/HM` (gitlab.com mirror; upstream
https://vcgit.hhi.fraunhofer.de/jvet/HM).

### Patch 1 — `CMakeLists.txt`
- **Change**: removed `warnings-as-errors` from the GCC `bb_enable_warnings(...)` call.
- **Reason**: GCC 16 emits new `-Warray-bounds` diagnostics in `TComLoopFilter.cpp`.

### Patch 2 — `VideCapture.{h,cpp}` + `TDecCu.cpp`
- **Change**: `TDecCu::xReconInter` / `xIntraRecBlk` copy per-CU/TU prediction and
  residual into picture-sized side buffers keyed by `TComPic*`.
- **Reason**: HM keeps prediction/residual only in transient buffers and nulls the
  picture-level ones; needed for the prediction/residual views (ADR D7).

### Patch 3 — `VideCapture.{h,cpp}` + `TDecBinCoderCABAC.cpp` + `TDecCu.cpp`
- **Change**: every CABAC read (`decodeBin`/`decodeBinEP`/`decodeBinsEP`/
  `decodeAlignedBinsEP`/`decodeBinTrm`) calls `vide_hm::addBins(n)`;
  `xDecodeCU` marks the CU start and `xFinishDecodeCU` records its bin delta.
- **Reason**: per-CU `bits` column.

### Patch 4 — `VideCapture.{h,cpp}` + `TDecCu.cpp` (per-CU QP provenance, #7)
- **Change**: `xFinishDecodeCU` calls `vide_hm::recordCuQpCoded(pcCU, absPartIdx,
  getdQPFlag())`; the helper reports `QpSource::Coded` vs `Inherited`.
- **Reason**: distinguish a CU that explicitly coded `cu_qp_delta` from one that
  inherits the frame/slice QP (skip etc.).

### Patch 5 — `TComBitStream.h` + `TDecBinCoderCABAC.*` + `TDecEntropy.h` + `TDecSbac.h` + `TDecCu.cpp` + `TDecGop.cpp` + `VideCapture.{h,cpp}` (per-CU bit range, v0.38)
- **Change**: `TComInputBitstream::readByte` always does `m_numBitsRead += 8` (it
  did not track at all before), so `TDecBinCABAC::getNumBitsRead()` (new) is
  valid. `TDecEntropyIf`/`TDecEntropy`/`TDecSbac` expose `getNumBitsRead()` down
  to `TDecCu`. `markCuStart`/`recordCuBits` take the bit position and record
  `CuInfo`/`CodingNode` `bit_offset`/`bit_length`.
- **Change (substreams)**: `TDecGop::decompressSlice` records each substream's
  cumulative base (`recordSubstreamBase`); `TDecBinCABAC::init` marks the active
  substream (`setActiveSubstream`). Needed because wavefront/tile streams restart
  CABAC at 0 per substream — the base makes CU offsets **NAL-RBSP-relative**.
- **Reason**: per-CU bit range (block-level bit positioning, R7); offsets are
  relative to the NAL RBSP (after the start code, before EPB removal).

Added files are compiled automatically because `TLibDecoder` globs `*.cpp`.

## VTM (VVC Test Model) 19.2

Location: `external/VTM` (upstream
https://vcgit.hhi.fraunhofer.de/jvet/VVCSoftware_VTM). Built with
`ENABLE_TRACING=OFF` **and** `KEEP_PRED_AND_RESI_SIGNALS=1` (see
`scripts/build-vtm.ps1`); a tracing mismatch corrupts decoding.

### Patch 1 — `CMakeLists.txt`
- **Change**: removed `warnings-as-errors`; switched the `BBuildEnv.cmake`
  include to `${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}`.
- **Reason**: GCC 16 warnings become errors; absolute source-dir include breaks
  a non-top-level build.

### Patch 2 — `CommonLib/TypeDef.h`, `dtrace.h`, `Utilities/program_options_lite.h`
- **Change**: added `#include <cstdint>`.
- **Reason**: GCC 16 no longer transitively includes it.

### Patch 3 — `DecoderLib/VideCapture.{h,cpp}` + `DecLib.cpp` (full-frame snapshot)
- **Change**: `DecLib::finishPicture` calls `vide_vvc::capturePicture(m_pcPic)`
  immediately **before** `destroyTempBuffers()`. The hook snapshots
  pred/resi/reco (`CodingStructure::getPredBuf/getResiBuf`) and per-CU info into
  a global FIFO; the helper only drains it.
- **Reason**: VTM keeps picture-sized pred/resi buffers only until
  `destroyTempBuffers`; reading VTM structures from the helper raced with DPB
  recycling.

### Patch 4 — `DecoderLib/BinDecoder.cpp` + `CABACReader.cpp` (per-CU bits)
- **Change**: every `BinDecoderBase` bin read calls `vide_vvc::addBins(n)`;
  `CABACReader::coding_unit` marks CU start and records its bin delta.
- **Reason**: VTM does not record per-CU bit counts.

### Patch 5 — `DecoderLib/VideCapture.{h,cpp}` + `CABACReader.cpp` (real CU tree, v0.12)
- **Change**: `CABACReader::coding_tree` opens a `vide_vvc::CodingNodeScope` at
  entry (luma tree only) and calls `attachCodingNode` after the leaf CU is
  parsed; the hook keeps a per-`CodingStructure` parent stack, so the exported
  node list carries **real parent/child links** from the decoder recursion.
  `capturePicture` moves the node list into the frame capture.
- **Reason**: `CodingUnit` has no parent pointer and `cs->cus` keeps only leaves,
  so the partition tree cannot be recovered after decoding.
- **Also**: block grid is limited to luma CUs (`chType == LUMA`) so dual-tree
  chroma CUs no longer duplicate/overlap blocks.

### Patch 6 — `DecoderLib/VideCapture.{h,cpp}` + `CABACReader.cpp` (per-CU QP provenance, #7)
- **Change**: the two `cu_qp_delta()` call sites in `CABACReader` (transform_unit
  and palette escape) call `vide_vvc::recordCuQpCoded(&cu)` when the CU actually
  codes a delta; `CuInfo`/`CodingNode` carry `qp_coded`.
- **Reason**: distinguish a CU that coded `cu_qp_delta` (Coded) from one that
  inherits the slice QP (Inherited). `CUCtx::isDQPCoded` is quantization-group
  scoped, so it must be sampled at the delta call, not read post-hoc.

### Patch 7 — `CommonLib/BitStream.h` + `VideCapture.{h,cpp}` + `CABACReader.cpp` (per-CU bit range, v0.36)
- **Change**: `InputBitstream::readByte` always does `m_numBitsRead += 8` (was
  `#if ENABLE_TRACING`), so `CABACReader::get_num_bits_read()` is valid without
  tracing. `markCuStart`/`recordCuBits` now also take the reader's bit position
  and record `CuInfo`/`CodingNode` `bit_offset`/`bit_length`. `coding_unit`
  passes `get_num_bits_read()` and records on the skip and palette early returns
  too (previously those paths recorded no bits at all).
- **Reason**: per-CU bit range in the slice-data substream (block-level bit
  positioning, R7). `bit_offset` is relative to the CABAC substream (bit 0 = the
  slice-data substream start); absolute ES mapping is a later step.
- **Also (v0.37)**: `DecSlice::decompressSlice` records the slice-data start bit
  (`recordSliceDataStart(pic, bitstream->getNumBitsRead())`, first slice wins),
  so a CU's bit range maps back to the slice NAL RBSP: `rbsp_bit =
  slice_data_bit + cu.bit_offset`.
- **Note (v0.38/0.39)**: the VTM hook records `cu.bit_offset` **NAL-RBSP-relative**
  (substream base folded in; `DecSlice` records each substream's cumulative base
  and `CABACReader::initBitstream` marks the active substream), matching HM.

## JM (H.264/AVC reference decoder) 19.1

Location: `external/JM` (upstream https://vcgit.hhi.fraunhofer.de/jvet/JM).
Compiled by VidE's CMake into `vide_jm_decoder` (no separate build script).

### Compatibility patches
- `win32.h`: `intptr_t`; `ifunctions.h`: `static inline`/`po2`; CMake: remove
  `-Werror`; MinGW: link `ws2_32`; `defines.h`: `MVC_EXTENSION_ENABLE 0` (single
  view path).

### Hook — `VideCapture.{h,c}` + `image.c`
- **Change**: `exit_picture()` calls `vide_jm_capture_picture()`, which snapshots
  the finished `StorablePicture` (Y/Cb/Cr) and `mb_data[]` (geometry/QP/type/MV)
  into a FIFO.
- **Reason**: JM exposes no block-level API; this is the only source of AVC
  block information.

### Hook — `biaridecod.c` + `image.c` + `VideCapture.c` (per-MB bits, v0.6)
- **Change**: the three CABAC primitives (`biari_decode_symbol`,
  `biari_decode_symbol_eq_prob`, `biari_decode_final`) increment the global
  `vide_jm_bins`; the macroblock loop in `image.c` records each MB's delta via
  `vide_jm_capture_mb_bits(mbAddrX, ...)` into a side table that
  `VideCapture.c` attaches to `JmMbInfo.bits`.
- **Reason**: JM does not record per-MB bit counts.

### Hook — `VideCapture.{h,c}` (per-8x8 partitions, v0.12)
- **Change**: `JmMbInfo` gains `b8mode[4]`/`b8pdir[4]`, copied from `mb->b8mode`
  / `mb->b8pdir`, so the helper can emit a real macroblock → 8x8
  `sub_macroblock` tree.
- **Reason**: AVC's only recursion below the slice is MB → 8x8 sub-partitions.

### Hook — `macroblock.c` + `VideCapture.{h,c}` (per-MB QP provenance, #7)
- **Change**: `read_delta_quant()` calls `vide_jm_capture_mb_qp_coded(mbAddrX, 1)`
  when an MB codes `mb_qp_delta`; the capture attaches it to `JmMbInfo.qp_coded`.
- **Reason**: distinguish MBs that coded a QP delta (Coded) from those inheriting
  the slice QP (Inherited). JM's `delta_quant` is not reset per MB, so presence
  must be flagged at the parse point.

### Hook — `image.c` + `VideCapture.{h,c}` (per-MB pred/resi, v0.31)
- **Change**: after `decode_one_macroblock()`, `vide_jm_capture_mb_pred_resi()`
  copies `Slice::mb_pred`/`mb_rres` into per-frame int16 accumulators, attached
  (cropped) to the next capture.
- **Reason**: JM keeps prediction/residual only per-macroblock (16x16 scratch);
  a full-frame view requires accumulating during the MB loop.

### Hook — `image.c` + `biaridecod.c` + `VideCapture.{h,c}` (per-MB bit range, v0.39)
- **Change**: `image.c` records the slice's CABAC data start byte
  (`vide_jm_set_cabac_base(ByteStartPosition)`) and, per MB, the range
  `[arideco_bits_read(dep), ...)` (CAVLC falls back to `frame_bitoffset`); the
  values are stored in `JmMbInfo.bit_offset`/`bit_length` (NAL-RBSP-relative,
  i.e. including the 1-byte NAL header). `streamBuffer` skips the NAL header, so
  the base is `(ByteStartPosition + 1) * 8`.
- **Reason**: per-MB bit range (block-level bit positioning, R7).

## libvpx (VP9)

Location: `external/libvpx`, built in place by `scripts/build-vpx.sh`
(decoder-only static lib).

### Compatibility patch
- Remove `-Werror` from the generated makefiles (GCC 16 diagnostics).
- vidE hook code uses `(1 << (tx_size + 2))` for the transform block size (this
  libvpx predates `tx_size_wide[]`/`TX_UNIT_SIZE_LOG2`).

### Hook — `vp9/decoder/vp9_capture.{h,c}` + `vp9_decodeframe.c`
- **Change**: `decode_block()`/`parse_block()` (via `vide_vp9_capture_block`)
  record each leaf block's geometry/mode/MV/QP; `vp9_capture_frame` snapshots the
  reconstructed `YV12_BUFFER_CONFIG` into a FIFO.
- **Reason**: libvpx's public API exposes only pixels.

### Hook — `vpx_dsp/bitreader.{h,c}` + `vp9_decodeframe.c` + `vp9_detokenize.c` (bits, v0.6)
- **Change**: `vpx_reader` gains a `bins` counter incremented in `vpx_read`
  and in `vp9_detokenize.c:read_bool`; block decoders record begin/end deltas.
- **Reason**: per-block `bits` column. (VP9 residual tokens use the local
  `read_bool`, which is why both primitives are instrumented.)

### Hook — `vp9_capture.{h,c}` + `vp9_decodeframe.c` (real partition tree, v0.12)
- **Change**: `decode_partition`/`process_partition` open a
  `vide_vp9_capture_partition_begin/end` region (parent stack in the hook);
  `vide_vp9_capture_block` records each leaf block as a child. The node list
  (with real parent links) is copied into the frame capture.
- **Reason**: libvpx keeps only the reconstructed image and MI grid, not the
  partition tree.

### Hook — `vp9_capture.{h,c}` (per-block QP provenance, #7)
- **Change**: `vide_vp9_capture_block` sets `qp_coded` =
  `segfeature_active(&cm->seg, segment_id, SEG_LVL_ALT_Q)`.
- **Reason**: VP9 has no per-block QP delta; a block's QP is either the frame base
  (Inherited) or an explicit segment alt-Q (Coded).

### Hook — `vp9_capture.{h,c}` + `vp9_decodeframe.c` (pred/resi, v0.31)
- **Change**: `vide_vp9_capture_residual_begin/end` wrap
  `inverse_transform_block_{intra,inter}` (4 call sites incl. row-mt) to record the
  per-transform residual; `vide_vp9_capture_prefilter_rows` snapshots the
  pre-loop-filter reconstruction before each LF row. `vide_vp9_capture_frame`
  derives `pred = prefilter − residual`.
- **Reason**: VP9 retains neither prediction nor residual; both are written in
  place into the frame buffer.

### Hook — `vp9_capture.c` (skip hidden frames, v0.31)
- **Change**: `vide_vp9_capture_frame` returns early when `!cm->show_frame`
  (resetting accumulators), so the pack holds only displayed frames in order.
- **Reason**: hidden ALTREF frames are reference-only and never output by
  `vpx_codec_get_frame`; capturing them misaligned the pack vs. the strip.

### Hook — `vpx_dsp/bitreader.{h,c}` + `vp9_capture.c` + `vp9_decodeframe.c` (per-block bit range, v0.39/0.40)
- **Change**: added `vpx_reader.buffer_start` + `vpx_reader_tell()` (consumed-bit
  position); `vp9_decode_frame` records the frame compressed-data base
  (`vide_vp9_capture_set_frame_data(data)`); block begin/end record
  `Vp9BlockInfo.bit_offset`/`bit_length` **frame-relative**
  (`(tile_data - frame_data)*8 + tell`; no EPB in VP9).
- **Reason**: per-block bit range (block-level bit positioning, R7). The IVF view
  (`indexIvf`) turns these into absolute ES bytes.

## libaom (AV1)

Location: `external/libaom`, built by hand into `build-aom/libaom.a` (see
`docs/03_build_guide.md` §2).

### Compatibility patch
- `cmake_minimum_required` 3.5 → 3.10.

### Hook — `av1/decoder/av1_capture.{h,c}` + `decodeframe.c`
- **Change**: `decode_block()` (via `vide_av1_capture_block`) records each leaf
  block's geometry/mode/MV/QP; `vide_av1_capture_frame` queues the block grid.
  Reconstruction is fetched via the public `aom_codec_get_frame`.
- **Reason**: libaom's public API exposes only pixels.

### Hook — `av1_capture.{h,c}` + `decodeframe.c` (bits, v0.6)
- **Change**: `vide_av1_capture_block_begin/end` snapshot
  `aom_reader_tell()` at the start/end of `decode_block`; the delta is stored as
  the block's `bits`.
- **Reason**: per-block `bits` column (real bit counts).

### Hook — `av1_capture.{h,c}` + `decodeframe.c` (real partition tree, v0.12)
- **Change**: `decode_partition` opens a `vide_av1_capture_partition_begin/end`
  region (parent stack in the hook); `vide_av1_capture_block` records each leaf
  block as a child. The node list with real parent links is copied into the
  frame capture.
- **Reason**: libaom's public API exposes no partition tree.

### Hook — `av1_capture.{h,c}` (per-block QP provenance, #7)
- **Change**: `vide_av1_capture_block` sets `qp_coded` = delta_q signalled at this
  block's superblock top-left (when `delta_q_present_flag`) or a segment with an
  active `SEG_LVL_ALT_Q`; and uses `xd->current_qindex` (not `cm->base_qindex`)
  so per-SB delta Q is reflected.
- **Reason**: distinguish an explicit per-block QP signal from the inherited
  base/previous QP.

### Hook — `av1_capture.c` (skip hidden frames, v0.31)
- **Change**: `vide_av1_capture_frame` returns early when `!cm->show_frame`
  (resetting accumulators); the pack then holds only displayed frames.
- **Reason**: hidden frames are reference-only and never returned by
  `aom_codec_get_frame`, so capturing them desynced the bridge's FIFO pairing.

### Hook — `av1_capture.{h,c}` + `decodeframe.c` (prediction / residual, v0.13)
- **Change**: `inverse_transform_block` brackets `av1_inverse_transform_block`
  with `vide_av1_capture_residual_begin/end`, which accumulate the exact
  residual (`reco - pred`) per plane; `vide_av1_capture_prefilter` snapshots the
  whole-frame reconstruction **before** loop filtering. The capture stores both,
  so the helper derives `pred = prefilter - residual`.
- **Reason**: libaom's public API exposes only the final reconstruction.
- **Note**: libaom allocates 16-bit frame buffers even for 8-bit streams in this
  build (`CONVERT_TO_SHORTPTR`). The capture detects this from
  `YV12_FLAG_HIGHBITDEPTH` and reads samples accordingly. `aom_image_t.bit_depth`
  can read 8 while `fmt` has `AOM_IMG_FMT_HIGHBITDEPTH`; `copy_image` in the
  helper now decides the sample size from the format flag.

### Hook — `aom_dsp/daalaboolreader.{h,c}` + `av1_capture.{h,c}` + `decodeframe.c` (per-block bit range, v0.39/0.40)
- **Change**: added `daala_reader.buffer_start`; `av1_decode_frame` records the
  frame compressed-data base (`vide_av1_capture_set_frame_data(data)`); block
  begin/end record `Av1BlockInfo.bit_offset`/`bit_length` **frame-relative**
  (`(tile_data - frame_data)*8 + aom_reader_tell`).
- **Reason**: per-block bit range (block-level bit positioning, R7). The IVF view
  (`indexIvf`) turns these into absolute ES bytes.

## FFmpeg

Used as a system library via `pkg-config` (no source patches). FFmpeg only
provides container probing, Annex-B extraction, thumbnails and the
`export_mvs` fallback.
